prompt: Create an original 60 second acoustic swing jazz instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: acoustic guitar, violin, upright bass. Style: crisp rhythmic guitar and playful violin phrases. Tempo approximately 156 BPM; C major. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A lively and intricate classical-style piece featuring a prominent violin melody, supported by other strings and a plucked string instrument. It has a folk-dance feel.
description.zh: 一首活泼精致的古典风格乐曲，以小提琴旋律为主，辅以其他弦乐器和拨弦乐器。具有民间舞曲的感觉。
